canonical_name: Native geometric engine (Line B: typed values, version chains, grounded replies)
plain_what: A small language model written from scratch in Rust that treats words as exact prime-number addresses and keeps its memory as rotations in four-dimensional geometry. It learns which earlier word or number to copy, add or stop on, and which version of a changing fact to read. It answered authored questions exactly but never wrote free prose.
how_it_works: Each token has a full prime address and ordered two-prime keys name contexts. Eight fixed zeta-zero phase channels, compiled to 16-bit turns, give position-like phases. A window of recent tokens is folded in order into exact H4 (icosian) coordinates with exact Z[phi] sums, signed chirality and bounded eviction. A readout of conditional score tables plus seven gated feature groups (coefficients quantised in eighths, bounded shift-add) predicts the next piece. On top sit small learned selector tables, each fitted on constructed families: which source occurrence to read, whether to write an exact owner-value relation (sixteen versions kept), whether to Copy, Add or Stop on typed numeric literals, how deep to read, and which version intent (initial, previous or current) to follow along a validated chain, abstaining when a chain is truncated. A shared geometric writer emits the answer. In October the same line trained Q4 'cross-state' coefficients over categorical H4 banks (Context, Prefix, Generate) with exact integer scoring and a pooled-token ranking objective, reaching 437 of 512 complete replies on its exposed development panel. Exact occurrence and version identity stays separate from geometric addresses, and digests are never used as semantic features. Training used floating point; serving executes the quantised integer scores. The preserved source is excluded from the current build by cfg(any()) and the native_support.rs facade.
geometry: Prime registry and ordered n-lets; fixed zeta-zero phase channels; H4/icosian (R4/S3) window fold; exact Z[phi] arithmetic; chirality and cosine polarity; Hopf S3-to-S2 observation with the fibre kept explicitly; 120-root leaf assignment (prime modulo 120); Q4 coefficient grids over categorical H4 action banks; exact E8 transport and retained-state copy credit in the October source.

status_reason: PARKED: authored-panel passes never reached prose (eras 18-19: generated prose 0/5), M2 437/512 collapsed to 0/128 on fresh rows (docs/labs/m2-fresh-437-2026-10-10/README.md), its pooled-ranking objective uses softplus/exp (D23/D25), and Line B kernels were quarantined by D29. The one-exact-writer idea lives on in the discrete path.
reopen_conditions: The owner lifts the separate M2 training/rental hold and a new pre-registration with TEST FITNESS: FIT replaces the softplus/exp pooled ranking with a lawful rank-margin hinge (D23/D25) and runs on the GPU in its own scanned module (D37).
The decisive panel is a genuinely unexposed draw of at least 200 fresh rows or at least 2 seeds (D22), not the 512-row development panel that was fit.
The quarantined native-context and selected-potential kernels are rebuilt without the hidden dense contraction and re-qualified (D29 correction in docs/labs/d29-module-split-2026-10-13/README.md).
Line B is joined to the shared integer vector writer so the compiler/emitter path and the language path use one geometric representation (AGENTS.md owner clarification).
The relation-read reranker (D34) produces a result that needs exact multi-version identity memory; that is the natural route back for the version-chain selectors.

rule_compat.D11: Partly. The engine's own scores are quantised integers executed with bounded shift/add, and it ships an integer realizer that ran source-free in a restricted chroot (28 replies, 178 actions reproduced). Host tokenization, fitting and reports use floating point, and no complete-binary D11 audit of the native engine is recorded.
rule_compat.D23: Non-compliant in the M2 line. The pooled-token ranking loss is softplus of a log mass ratio with log-sum-exp episode weighting and softmax(ell) token weights (docs/labs/m2-pooled-rank-2026-10-10/README.md); the Sept engine's f64 softmax sampler was flagged in 1284. D23 and D25 made the path non-compliant for new runs.
rule_compat.D30: Unclear for the Sept engine: its fitting was table search with host floating point, and offline matmul was then permitted (docs/native_geometric_workflow.md). D29 quarantined the Line B native-context (14 kernels) and selected-potential (1 kernel) modules after a hidden dense contraction was found. October Line B added CUDA integer scoring; no GPU-only fitting path for the Sept engine appears in the records read.
rule_compat.D32_D37: Offline float learning with straight-through gradients over Q4 coefficients would be legal under D37 once its objective is lawful and its module is separately scanned; the discrete path (crates/uor-r4-discrete) supersedes it for the active model. Export gap is built in (Q4) but never reported against a float score.

The ordinary-gradient reply recipes (2 of 8, 4 of 512, 0/512): single-recipe failures on 24 to 512 examples at one learning rate, with a prototype or joint parameter family that destabilised working replies.
Shared-core experiment 1.425% vs 2%: one predeclared configuration of a 1.68M-parameter model.
Decoder refit, block learning and credit-assignment negatives: calibrations of particular heads in a small model, each preserved at its exact scope.
Shared H4 transitions 186/288 vs ordinary 288/288: the ordinary comparator was a finite table given the same supervision, so this tests a configuration of H4 transitions, not rotation as a mechanism.
Fixed geometric readout 0.13%: an unlearned readout; the learned readout replaced it.
Interior 'will' names: a context-word barrier localised at one key, with no repair attempted.

figure_ideas: A version-chain picture: a fact (a locker number) edited three times, drawn as a chain of boxes with arrows; the learned selector points at 'initial', 'previous' or 'current' depending on the question, and abstains when the chain is cut.

The M2 ladder as a staircase from 8 to 22 to 145 to 177 to 437 of 512 on the development panel, with a trapdoor at the right end dropping to 0 of 128 on fresh rows, so a reader sees development is not transfer.

Word to address to rotation: a word becomes a prime, a window of words is folded into one icosian rotation drawn on a sphere, a Z[phi] bar shows the exact sum, and a small phase dial shows the eight fixed zeta phases.
